title: Ants walking over each other, in motion: does the colony stream or jam?
question: Which pane reads as ants going about their business rather than jamming - and in that pane, is anything standing on nothing?
context_md:
You answered the still version of this (`20260823T152556591Z-7c87cf`) with
*"need an animation to tell"*. Same question, in motion: **20 frames, 6 ticks
apart — 2 seconds of play — on one shared scrubber, so both panes step to the
same instant.** Drag it or press the arrow keys.

**The change.** A living nestmate counts as **ground**: footing only, never
passability, so two ants still cannot walk through each other. It is the
deliberate re-test of a dead end (775/829) whose own condition line said to
re-open it *"if creatures gain pass-through or climb-over"*. It is one line in
`ant.ron` either way, and it is currently **off** — this card decides that.

**What is different from the first card, and why.** That one used the default
world seed and had 17 ants. The default seed now panics in the scene, and of
the seeds that do work, several plant most of the colony *on a lake* — so this
is `seed=12`, 31 ants, on a hill the colony has dug a chamber into. Captured at
noon (`start=1200`), because the scene's 2,400-frame warmup otherwise lands the
capture two thirds through the day/night cycle and the first attempt came back
as a sheet of night.

**The numbers, deliberately not attributed to a pane.** `forage_probe`,
medians of 8 seeds, both arms, same seeds, re-measured after the sessile-colony
bug was closed — the earlier card's figures were taken while the colony was not
foraging at all and should be ignored:

| | one arm | the other |
|---|---|---|
| deliveries | 643 | 270 |
| falls | 968 | 1,783 |
| moves | 9,746 | 10,889 |
| forage trips, over a terrain bridge | 22 | 233 |
| deepest excursion, same scene | 16 | 74 |

So the trade is real and it divides by scene: over terrain that has to be
negotiated it is transformative; in the plain foraging loop it **halves
deliveries** for no gain in trips, while falls nearly double. The work
package's rule is *land default-on only if one arm clearly wins with
deliveries flat*. They are not flat. That is why this is your call and not
mine — and why the panes are blind.

**One thing to ignore, because I already checked it.** At the far right of the
frame there is open water, and an ant or two is standing on its surface. That
is in **both** panes, it happens with this change off, and it is not this
change: `found_colony` will plant an ant on a liquid surface, and nothing
afterwards makes it sink. Filed as §R of `Reports/open-bugs-handoff.md`.

Rendered on the `gutbias` overlay — ants are 2 cells each and invisible against
soil otherwise. Pale = a neutral omnivore gut, which is what every ant is.
